description: A 32-item, face-supported Likert questionnaire adapted from the Achievement Emotion Questionnaire–Elementary School to measure primary pupils’ enjoyment, anxiety, and boredom when learning English as a second language.
title: AEQ-ES adapted to English as L2 for primary school children

description: A structured curriculum module for medical students that develops attitudes, ethics, communication skills, and sociocultural and medico-legal understanding, delivered within medical education programmes.
title: AETCOM (Attitude, Ethics, and Communication) module
